description: Stairs climb: bot walks from base platform up compound-step staircase; bot.pos.y increases monotonically, no respawn fires.
geometry: scenario-stairs map — base platform of colored_block_blue plus prototype_primitive_stairs with compound-step colliders (8 steps, stepRise=0.5m, stepRun=0.5m); stair ascent direction: -X; top of stairs at world Y≈6m

spawnPoint.description: Base of stairs — bot spawns on the flat base platform and walks toward the stair entry

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.y within 0.3 of base platform top (y≈2) and bot has not yet reached stair footprint
keyframes.description: Bot settled on base platform before beginning the climb

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.y > 2.5 and bot.pos.y < 5.5 (somewhere mid-staircase, clearly ascending)
keyframes.description: Bot partway up the staircase; pos.y monotonically increasing

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.y within 0.3 of stair top height (y≈6) and bot.vel.y ≈ 0 (settled)
keyframes.description: Bot reached the top of the staircase and settled
